title: Duta Qur'an
lead: A special training in Makkah for selected Qur'an specialists and preachers — the skills of tadabbur, linking the Qur'an's values to everyday life, and running a Tadarus circle.
seo: Duta Qur'an (Qur'an Ambassadors): tadabbur training in Makkah for preachers and teachers with the an-Naba' al-'Azhim Academy, with Umrah.
whatsapp:
Assalamu'alaikum warahmatullah wabarakatuh.

I would like to ask about the Duta Qur'an programme.

aims.title: Goal
items: Preparing ambassadors for Markaz Tadarus Indonesia and the an-Naba' al-'Azhim Academy who can reflect on the Qur'an and live its values every day.

strengths.title: What makes it special
items: It takes place in the holy city of Makkah.
Visits to historic places in Makkah with the an-Naba' Academy.
A certificate accredited by the an-Naba' Academy.
A training book pack.

rows: Arrival in Makkah, to the hotel
Course "The 5T Tadarus Circle": theory and practice
Courses "Guidance of the Qur'an" and "Applying the verses to reality"

who.title: Who can join
items: Men or women.
At least a bachelor's degree in Islamic studies.
Influential in da'wah, especially in the Qur'an and its sciences.
Has a da'wah institution to run the programme in.
Aged 25–60.
Fluent and active in Arabic.
Skilled and regular in reciting the Qur'an.
Able to translate Arabic texts into Indonesian.
Sound Islamic belief and thought (not deviant or liberal).
No police record and of good character.
Recommended by the institution they serve.
Committed to attending 100% of the training, theory and practice.

documents.title: Documents
items: A recommendation from the institution.
Passport.
ID card.
CV.
